markdown:
Fate is a fickle matter on Golarion. Even with prophecy broken on the world, there are ways to look to the immediate future or acquire a vague sense of long-term events. Omen dragons are bound to see the future—nebulous though it might be—at all times. Visions of the future hound them like a quiet song that never stops playing in their minds. While an omen dragon can focus on or ignore the music of fate at any time, the song plays all the same. At a glance, omen dragons resemble other occult dragons in appearance, save for the mirror-like interior membrane of their wings. An omen dragon's wings offer glimpses into the future. These glimpses are cloudy and vague, but generally correct, if only technically. Omen dragons have a natural compulsion to share the futures they see. These dragons have no compunctions about what the visions show and share their knowledge equally with innocent villagers as they do with wicked tyrants. **[Recall Knowledge - Dragon](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35)): DC 37 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 35 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 32 [Ancient Omen Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2955) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 125 **Perception** +29; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Monsters.aspx?ID=109)) 60 feet **Languages** [Aklo](/Languages.aspx?ID=13), [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2), [Fey](/Languages.aspx?ID=119), [Jotun](/Languages.aspx?ID=8) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +28, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +30, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +29, [Fortune-Telling Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +33, [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +31, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) +33, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) +31 **Str** +8 **Dex** +6 **Con** +7 **Int** +9 **Wis** +7 **Cha** +5 --- **AC** 38 **Fort** +27 **Ref** +28 **Will** +29 +2 status to all saves vs. [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=662) **HP** 280 **Immunities** [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=63), [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=67), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=696) **Untethered to Fate** The dragon can choose to negate any [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=612) or [misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=654) effects that would affect them; other creatures remain affected normally.
**Challenge Fate** ([misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=654), [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=662)) **Trigger** The dragon is targeted by an attack; **Effect** This fate is not set in stone. The attacker rolls the triggering attack twice and uses the worse result. --- **Speed** 60 feet, fly 180 feet **Melee** jaws +30 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d8+14 piercing plus 1d8 mental **Melee** claw +30 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d6+14 slashing plus 1d8 mental **Melee** tail +28 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d8+14 bludgeoning plus 1d8 mental **Melee** wing +28 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 2d8+14 slashing plus 1d8 mental **Occult Innate Spells** DC 39 - **Cantrips (8th)** [Guidance](/Spells.aspx?ID=142) - **7th** [Ill Omen](/Spells.aspx?ID=696) (at will), [Mindlink](/Spells.aspx?ID=195) (at will), [True Target](/Spells.aspx?ID=346) (×2) - **8th** [Retrocognition](/Spells.aspx?ID=260) **Destiny Breath** ([Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) The dragon breathes a translucent mist of potentialities that overwhelms creatures with visions of possible features, dealing 15d6 mental damage in a 40-foot cone (DC 39 Will save). A creature that fails its save is [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) for 1 round (or slowed 2 on a critical failure) as it struggles with the visions. The dragon can't use Destiny Breath again for 1d4 rounds. **Impending Fate** The dragon's attacks bring their foes closer to their eventual fates. When the dragon critically hits with a Strike or a creature critically fails against the dragon's Destiny Breath, the creature becomes [doomed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=67), or increases its doomed value by 1 if it was already doomed. **Draconic Frenzy** The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one wing Strike in any order. **Draconic Momentum** The dragon recharges their Destiny Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike. **Prophetic Wings** The dragon or any ally can glimpse into the future through the dragon's wings in a process that requires 10 minutes of concentration. This casts a 8th-rank [_augury_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1445) spell, except that the wings can predict results up to 1 day into the future and the dragon always speaks a few cryptic words related to the result of the prediction. The dragon can use their wings in this way only once per hour, and a given creature can seek a future in the wings only once per week.
A creature can also choose to predict events up to 1 month into the future—the dragon can view a month ahead in their own wings only once per day.
A creature can also choose to predict events up to 1 year into the future—the dragon can view a year ahead in their own wings only once per day. **Walk the Timelines** ([Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** The dragon splits themself into two versions with different fates. Each copy Strides or [Flies](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312)from the dragon's current space, then takes a single action. If the actions are both attacks, they use the same multiple attack penalty and count as one attack toward the dragon's multiple attack penalty. After both actions, the dragon chooses one of the two locations as their actual destination and the other version of themself disappears.
